title: Implement ClaudeHarness adapter for swappable vendor harnesses

story.as_a: Infrastructure engineer maintaining the agentic workflow orchestration system
story.i_want: Implement a ClaudeHarness class that implements the common.harness.Harness protocol and is swappable with DevinHarness via environment variable indirection
story.so_that: The Claude CLI can be used as an alternative harness provider for skill activities, providing identical interface and behavior parity with DevinHarness

journey.before: Currently only Devin harness is available for skill-activity invocations; adding a second harness provider requires code changes to multiple modules and every skill config file
journey.during: Configure Claude as an alternative harness via <WORKFLOW>_HARNESS environment variable; implement protocol-compliant adapter; verify feature parity with Devin behavior
journey.after: Multiple harness providers (Devin, Claude) are available and swappable at runtime via environment variable; workflows can run with either CLI without code changes; trajectory telemetry and usage metrics are captured consistently regardless of harness

capability_breakdown.core_action: Implement a Claude CLI harness adapter that conforms to the common.harness.Harness protocol, enabling drop-in replacement of DevinHarness
inputs: Activity logging context (if running inside a Cadence activity)
outputs: HarnessResult containing exit_code, stdout, stderr, and optional HarnessUsage telemetry
NDJSON trajectory file (when Activity context exists) or temporary trajectory (discarded after parse)
Structured logging events emitted to activity_logger and harness-specific logger
state_changes: Trajectory artifact written to activity artifact directory (durable) or temporary file (ephemeral)
Activity log populated with harness execution metadata and telemetry
Harness-specific log file created with debug-level stdout/stderr capture

affected_components.common.skill_activity: Reads generalized config namespace and exposes agent-agnostic telemetry fields
affected_components.common.workflow_logger: Provides generalized agent_log_path and trajectory_path accessors
affected_components.common.atif_usage: Refactored to share vendor-neutral coercion helpers
affected_components.story_analysis_workflow: Harness instance swapped via environment variable
affected_components.story_design_workflow: Harness instance swapped via environment variable
affected_components.edd_refinement_workflow: Harness instance swapped via environment variable

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ClaudeHarness implements the Harness protocol with run(prompt, *, cwd, config) signature
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a ClaudeHarness instance When run() is called with prompt, cwd, and config Then it returns a HarnessResult with exit_code, stdout, stderr, and usage fields
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Conform to the Harness interface contract

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ClaudeHarness has a zero-argument constructor for environment-variable instantiation
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a <WORKFLOW>_HARNESS env var set to module:ClaudeHarness When harness_instance.py calls cls() Then ClaudeHarness() is instantiated without error
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Enable harness swapping via environment variable

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ClaudeHarness invokes 'claude -p' non-interactively with explicit --permission-mode and --model
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a skill activity invocation When ClaudeHarness.run() is called Then subprocess.run(['claude', '-p', '--permission-mode', <mode>, '--model', <model>, '--output-format', 'stream-json', '--verbose', '--', prompt], ...) is executed
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Invoke Claude CLI in non-interactive mode with explicit configuration

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Config namespace isolation: reads only 'claude' namespace, leaves 'devin' and other namespaces untouched
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a config dict with both 'claude' and 'devin' namespaces When ClaudeHarnessConfig.from_mapping() is called Then only 'claude' keys are parsed, 'devin' is ignored, and no error is raised
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Support both harness providers in a single config file during migration

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Permission modes validated against supported set; secure defaults applied
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an invalid permission_mode value When ClaudeHarnessConfig.from_mapping() is called Then error_category='invalid_value: claude.permission_mode' is raised; and defaults to 'dontAsk' (fail-closed) when not specified
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Enforce least-privilege permission defaults

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Model field validated: rejects non-string or blank values with error_category='invalid_value: claude.model'
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a config with non-string or blank model When ClaudeHarnessConfig.from_mapping() is called Then validation error is raised
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Prevent invalid model configuration

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Captures NDJSON stream-json output for full trajectory and per-message usage
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose ... When the subprocess completes Then stdout contains NDJSON events (system/init, assistant, user, tool_result, result)
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Capture full execution trajectory for audit and analysis

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Trajectory file written to durable artifact directory when Activity context exists
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an Activity logging context When run() completes Then trajectory is written to get_activity_artifact_dir()/claude-trajectory.jsonl and retained
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Retain execution trajectory for audit

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Trajectory file parsed then deleted when no Activity context exists
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given no Activity context When run() completes Then trajectory is written to temporary file, parsed for usage, and deleted before returning
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Avoid accumulating temporary trajectory files

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Usage metrics extracted from terminal 'result' event with best-effort parsing
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given NDJSON stream with terminal result event When read_claude_usage_result() is called Then usage object is parsed and returned as HarnessUsage, or None if parsing fails
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Extract cost and token metrics from execution

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Only four fields normalized to HarnessUsage: prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, cost_usd
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given result event with additional fields When HarnessUsage is constructed Then only the four named fields are populated; booleans are rejected; unknown fields dropped
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Extract standardized cost metrics

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Process result (exit_code, stdout, stderr) passed through unchanged for all outcomes
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a non-zero exit, truncated trajectory, or malformed JSON When run() returns Then exit_code, stdout, stderr are unchanged; usage is None; no exception is raised
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Preserve process result independently from telemetry extraction

acceptance_criteria.criterion: OSError on process launch (binary not found, permission denied) converted to RuntimeError('claude_launch_failed')
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given claude binary not found or permission denied When subprocess.run() raises OSError Then RuntimeError('claude_launch_failed') is raised after logging; both loggers record error_category=claude_launch_failed
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Detect and report harness launch failures

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Logging emits sanitized metadata without leaking prompt text or raw trajectory
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a complete invocation When logs are written Then storage mode, exit code, duration, usage-availability are logged; prompt text, raw NDJSON, tool arguments are not logged at INFO level; raw output may be logged at DEBUG level only
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Maintain audit trail without exposing sensitive content

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Logging emits same event taxonomy as DevinHarness (SelectTelemetrySource, StartInvocation, CompleteInvocation)
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a harness invocation When logging occurs Then SelectClaudeTelemetrySource, StartClaudeInvocation, CompleteClaudeInvocation events are emitted with consistent field set
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Enable consistent log parsing and analysis across harness types

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Shared coercion helpers (_token, _cost) extracted to common/harness_usage.py
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given vendor-agnostic _token() and _cost() functions When both DevinHarness and ClaudeHarness are used Then both import from the same shared module
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Eliminate code duplication between vendor parsers

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Config accepts MappingProxyType (read-only) without mutability assumptions
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a MappingProxyType config (as produced by SkillActivityConfig._freeze) When ClaudeHarnessConfig.from_mapping() is called Then parsing succeeds using .get() and membership checks only
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Accept frozen configs from activity loader

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Generalized logger accessor: agent_log_path replaces devin_log_path
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given SkillActivityOutput with agent_log_path field When getters are called Then the path points to the harness-specific log file regardless of which harness ran
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Provide harness-agnostic log path accessor

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Generalized trajectory accessor: trajectory_path replaces atif_path
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given SkillActivityOutput with trajectory_path field When getters are called Then the path points to devin-trajectory.json or claude-trajectory.jsonl depending on which harness ran
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Provide harness-agnostic trajectory path accessor

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Usage metrics are populated for Claude (unlike current Devin implementation which returns None cost_usd)
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a successful claude -p invocation When HarnessUsage is parsed Then cost_usd is populated from terminal result event (non-None), providing real cost visibility
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Capture real USD cost from Claude API usage

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Open question resolution required before implementation: stdout semantics
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given HarnessResult.stdout When multiple consumers read it Then it is clear whether stdout contains only the terminal result event's text field or the full raw NDJSON blob
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Define expected content of stdout field

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Open question resolution required before implementation: config namespace selection
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given multiple harnesses configured via env var When SkillActivity needs to read model/permission_mode from config Then the mechanism for selecting which namespace to read ('devin' vs 'claude') without editing every config file is decided
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Enable harness swapping without config file changes
